summary_1line: Sugriva dispatches monkey search parties in all directions while Hanuman departs with Rama’s ring to seek Sita.

image_candidates.scene_text: Hanuman bows before Rama with the ring pressed to his forehead as the monkey hosts gather behind him.
A vast army of monkeys spreads across the land like locusts as they depart in different directions under Sugriva’s command.
Hanuman, Angada, and Tara lead a southern expedition across rugged terrain toward the distant lands of Agastya.
